# Dialog, drawer

<!-- MAP:START (generated by .kiro/scripts/build-docs.py from rp-map.json) -->
**`rp-dialog-overlay`** = `Dialog` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/Dialog` · Figma: Dialog · no class = `maxWidth="sm"`

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-dialog` | the Dialog paper |
| `rp-dialog-title` | DialogTitle |
| `rp-dialog-title-text` | title column |
| `rp-dialog-title-label` | DialogTitle title |
| `rp-dialog-title-secondary` | DialogTitle subtitle |
| `rp-dialog-content` | DialogContent |
| `rp-dialog-actions` | DialogActions |
| `rp-dialog-max-width-xs` | maxWidth="xs" |
| `rp-dialog-max-width-md` | maxWidth="md" |
| `rp-dialog-max-width-lg` | maxWidth="lg" |
| `rp-dialog-max-width-xl` | maxWidth="xl" |
| `rp-dialog-full-screen` | fullScreen |

**`rp-drawer-overlay`** = `Drawer` · `@reviewpro/ui-components/Drawer` · Figma: Drawer / SidebarPanel · no class = `anchor="left" width="default" variant="default"`

| Class | Code |
|---|---|
| `rp-drawer` | the Drawer paper |
| `rp-drawer-title` | DrawerTitle |
| `rp-drawer-title-label` | DrawerTitle text |
| `rp-drawer-content` | DrawerContent |
| `rp-drawer-footer` | DrawerFooter (DrawerFooterActions) |
| `rp-drawer-anchor-right` | anchor="right" |
| `rp-drawer-below-nav-bar` | belowNavBar |
| `rp-drawer-width-small` | width="small" |
| `rp-drawer-width-medium` | width="medium" |
| `rp-drawer-width-large` | width="large" |
| `rp-drawer-width-xlarge` | width="xlarge" |
| `rp-drawer-width-full-width` | width="fullWidth" |
| `rp-drawer-secondary` | variant="secondary" |
| `rp-drawer-overlay-hide-backdrop` | hideBackdrop |
<!-- MAP:END -->

Both are hidden until `.open`. Open with `data-rp-open="id"` (or `rpOpen('id')`); the X (`data-rp-close`), the backdrop and Escape close them; focus stays inside while open.

## Dialog
`Dialog` default `maxWidth="sm"` (600px). Confirmations use `rp-dialog-max-width-xs` (444px), forms `md` (900px).
```html
<div class="rp-dialog-overlay" id="deleteDialog">
  <div class="rp-dialog rp-dialog-max-width-xs" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="deleteDialog-title">
    <div class="rp-dialog-title">
      <h2 class="rp-dialog-title-label" id="deleteDialog-title">Delete this user?</h2>
      <button type="button" class="rp-icon-button" data-rp-close aria-label="Close"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-close"></span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="rp-dialog-content" data-rp-form><p>The user loses access to every establishment. You cannot undo this action.</p></div>
    <div class="rp-dialog-actions">
      <button type="button" class="rp-default-button rp-default-button-size-small" data-rp-close>Cancel</button>
      <button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small rp-main-button-danger" data-rp-close data-rp-snackbar="User deleted">Delete user</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
Title: the decision ("Delete this user?") or the action ("Create Alert"); never "Are you sure?". The main button repeats the action ("Delete user", not "OK").

## Drawer
`Drawer` default `anchor="left"`: side panels open from the right, so add `rp-drawer-anchor-right`. Widths: default 360px, `rp-drawer-width-small | medium | large | xlarge | full-width` (20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100vw).
```html
<div class="rp-drawer-overlay" id="userDrawer">
  <aside class="rp-drawer rp-drawer-anchor-right rp-drawer-width-medium" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="userDrawer-title">
    <div class="rp-drawer-title"><h2 class="rp-drawer-title-label" id="userDrawer-title">Add User</h2><button type="button" class="rp-icon-button" data-rp-close aria-label="Close"><span class="rp-icon rp-icon-close"></span></button></div>
    <div class="rp-drawer-content" data-rp-form>… fields …</div>
    <div class="rp-drawer-footer">
      <button type="button" class="rp-default-button rp-default-button-size-small" data-rp-close>Cancel</button>
      <button type="button" class="rp-main-button rp-main-button-size-small" data-rp-validate="Invitation sent to the new user">Add user</button>
    </div>
  </aside>
</div>
```
Use a drawer for filters, create / edit forms of a list and detail views (a review, a case); a dialog for confirmations and short forms. Put overlays at the end of `<body>`.
